sections.title: Bioengineering Graduate Seminar
sections.description: This is a required course for BE PhD candidates and covers topics related to bioengineering and the PhD level graduate studies. The goal is to expose students to a breadth of bioengineering topics beyond their specific dissertation work.

sections.title: Bioengineering Seminar
sections.description: This is a required course for BE PhD candidates and involves attendance at seminars related to bioengineering topics, which can be either within the departmental seminar series or through other relevant seminar series on campus. The goal is to expose students to a breadth of bioengineering topics beyond their specific dissertation work. Students are required to submit summaries of the attended seminars to receive course credit.
